paper_role: minimal mechanism ablation; separate from the formal P1/P2/S2 matrix
source_suite: P2_cross_g plus one historically frozen S2 unit panel

selection.selection_rule: fixed before ablation timing; one graph per size/structure regime, three predeclared group counts, and one query from each of five input-size strata

panels.question: incremental contribution of DirectedCut and the Adjoint replacement
contribution of endpoint-floor inside the common A1 continuation cone

isolated_build.forbidden: runtime switch, graph/g/time/state-dependent branch, or any other source/configuration change
isolated_build.exactness: FarthestRemaining remains an admissible 1-Lipschitz continuation; this weakens pruning only

panels.question: cumulative state-pruning contribution of Enhanced unit rooted-entry and the reverse independent packing
panels.selection_rule: all 11 IMDb g14 queries whose pre-V23 historical Enhanced solver time exceeded 10000 seconds

variants.only_allowed_semantic_change: make RootedEntryCoverLower return zero, omit the unit first-hit/nonterminal/block-cover views, and disable construction/consumption of the reverse independent packing; retain UnitKeyQueue and every other production operation
prevent ResidualClosureScheduler from buying the reverse independent packing; retain the full unit rooted-entry bound and primary packing

panels.forbidden: runtime switches, graph-name/f/time/state branches, extending an ablated timeout, or changing the exact integer queue

reporting: completed/5 for P2 panels and completed/11 for the unit panel
paired runtime on jointly completed queries
stop_conditions: isolated build diff is not exactly the registered semantic change
interpretation_guards: do not combine per-query best variants
do not use ablation to replace main experiments
report regressions and timeouts without removing cells
